patterns.title: Composite Spacing
patterns.failureMode: Individual CSS values can match while cumulative rendered distances and overall container height diverge.
checks: Map enclosing Figma region to real app region and measure parent boundary, each child boundary, and next sibling.
Check actual previous.bottom to next.top, total content height, scroll/footer placement, and upstream padding or collapsing margins.

patterns.title: Hit Target Vs Vector
patterns.failureMode: Visible symbol size is confused with interactive hit rectangle or icon wrapper.
checks: Measure click target bounds, icon wrapper bounds, and visible SVG/vector footprint separately.
Check spacing to adjacent label plus focus/hover/touch states.

patterns.title: Mixed Inline Linebox
patterns.failureMode: Mixed inline text styling changes actual line-box height and shifts the full card.
checks: Measure final text line boxes and wrapping with baseline copy; compare parent card and next sibling after applying styles.
Test long copy and a line-break boundary width in the real application.

patterns.title: Wrap Boundary Responsive
patterns.failureMode: A centered min-height text container moves when a sentence changes between one and multiple lines.
checks: Check just before, at, and after actual wrap threshold, including any user-reported exact widths.
Compare top anchoring, parent height, actual line count, and dependent siblings on real app route.

patterns.title: State Transition Navigation
patterns.failureMode: Valid independent operations interact through watchers/guards and cause navigation races.
checks: Trace click, async work, state reset, watchers, guards, navigation, and unmount.
Test success, cancellation, watcher-first ordering and repeated-click execution in the real app.

patterns.title: False Audit Completeness
patterns.failureMode: Build pass, source-only fixture, and subordinate review can be reported as full Figma/runtime verification.
checks: Record Figma UI vs local runtime vs source-only vs inference evidence per property.
Require second independent full-scope sweep and explicit unmatched layer/state inventory.
